$comment: Every site that uses the widget. `npm run update-sites` opens one PR per site that moves it to this package's current release. dir: where the site's package.json is. branch (optional, default main): the branch the PR is based on, for a site whose live line is not main. install: npm or pnpm. merge: auto (arm GitHub auto-merge, the site's required checks decide), after-checks (wait for the named checks on the PR head, then merge that exact head) or manual (the site's rules need a step the script cannot do; the note says which). labels and bodyFooter carry each site's PR conventions.

merge.note: Nudge needs a cross-model review on every runtime change, a version bump included: run its cross-model-review skill on the PR, add the Author-Model-Family / Author-Model / Reviewed-By-Model-Family trailers to the body, wait for pairing-check and Safety net on the head, then gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit <sha> (nudge-monorepo CLAUDE.md, Merge gate).

Aria OS merges when its aria-os verify job is green after one cross-model review, and a merge does not deploy: relaunch the installed app with /Users/pnm/bin/aria-os and check its health (aria-os README and PLAN Run rules).

amythake.com is built from the branch named here, not main (repo AGENTS.md: start from the live candidate). A bump needs the cross-model review on the PR head, then a merge; a merge does not deploy. Release review first, then production, with the booking deploy scripts in docs/cloudflare.md and docs/booking-preview.md, and check the Feedback button with one real send (Canceled, never Done). If production has moved to another branch, change branch here first.
